card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS headings
card.fires_on: Ordinary words written in all capitals inside headings or warning lines, such as IS, USE, IN, PRODUCTS and INFORMATION. It fires most on the word after the first capitalized heading word.

modes.label: Capitalized label headings
modes.description: Second or later word of an all-caps question or heading in a drug label.
modes.example: WHAT<< IS>> THE MOST IMPORTANT INFORMATION I SHOULD KNOW ABOUT

modes.label: Capitalized warning phrases
modes.description: The word USE or IN in all-caps warning or section titles.
modes.example: BOXED WARNING USE<< IN>> PREGNANCY When used in

modes.label: Capitalized menu or caution text
modes.description: A capitalized word in a website menu or a shouted instruction.
modes.example: DO NOT<< USE>> if the expiration date has passed .

card.plain: It marks plain words that appear in capital letters in headings and warning lines.
